description: This file contains unit tests for the AmqpValidator class in the context of messaging connectivity using AMQP protocol. It verifies validation logic for source and target configurations, immutability, header mappings, enforcement, and placeholder resolution.

classes.name: AmqpValidatorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for AmqpValidator, testing immutability and validation logic for sources and targets.

methods.name: testValidationOfEnforcement
methods.description: Tests validation of source enforcement configuration.

methods.name: testValidHeaderMapping
methods.description: Tests validation with correct header mapping.

methods.name: testInvalidHeaderMappingThrowsException
methods.description: Ensures exception is thrown for invalid header mapping with unresolved placeholders.

methods.name: testInvalidInputThrowsException
methods.description: Checks that invalid enforcement input throws the proper exception.

methods.name: testInvalidMatcherThrowsException
methods.description: Validates that mismatched headers in enforcement throw an exception.

methods.name: testValidMatchers
methods.description: Verifies that valid placeholders in enforcement are accepted.

methods.name: testValidPlaceholdersInTargetAddress
methods.description: Tests validation of placeholders within the target address string.

methods.name: newSourceBuilder
methods.description: Helper method to create reusable source builder instances with preset address and authorization context.
